Using a Stewart Platform Mill with a 5-axis tool setup and active vibration damping system, the High-Precision Milling and Grinding operation processes a milled part on a conveyor belt to produce a ground part that is transferred to a mobile robot, achieving a milling precision of ±0.005 mm, for 54 minutes.

A gear hobbing operation is performed on a Hobbing Machine for 37 minutes at a hobbing speed of 100 rpm and a feed rate of 0.1 mm/rev using a standard involute profile, transforming a broached component on a ConveyorBelt into a hobbied gear that is then transferred to a MobileRobot.

A horizontal milling operation is performed on a Horizontal Milling Machine for 24 minutes using a contour cutting path at a milling speed of 1200 rpm to achieve a surface finish of Ra 1.6 µm, starting with a milled part on the ConveyorBelt and producing a finished machined component also on the ConveyorBelt.

The honing operation is performed on a Honing Machine for 17 minutes to finish a honed cylinder with a 50 mm bore size using a 60 grit honing stone, transforming the input honed cylinder from the ConveyorBelt into a precision finished part that is then transferred to a MobileRobot.

Punching is performed on a Punch Press for 60 minutes to cut 10 mm punch holes in sheet metal fed from a ConveyorBelt, with a stroke speed of 1.5 mm/s and die alignment within a ±0.02 mm tolerance, resulting in a finished cut sheet metal product being transferred to a MobileRobot.
